title: Deploy copies code but never installs requirements
class_symptom: A deploy that ships code without installing dependencies leaves any requirement added after the server was built missing in production, while CI (which installs requirements) stays green.
mechanism: scripts/deploy.sh copies the release but never runs pip install, so the server's virtualenv only holds what was installed when the box was first built.

evidence: Pillow>=10.0 has been in requirements.txt since T-158 (#174, 2026-08-17) but was absent on prod until 2026-11-04.
Switching preview_card_v2 on returned HTTP 500 on every crawler preview (6 requests in about 1 minute) with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'PIL' at apps/referrals/preview_card.py:31.
apps/accounts/service.py:184 (Path-B evidence upload) imports the same module; 0 uploads were ever recorded.

measurements: 6 crawler-preview requests returned HTTP 500 in about 1 minute after the flag was switched on; the traceback names the missing module.
Installing Pillow 13.0.0 on prod removed the error.

detection.check: scripts/deploy.sh step 4b: pip install -r requirements.txt (no --upgrade; upgrade preview refuses version changes) + scripts/check_requirements_installed.py before migrate/probe/flip; tests/test_deploy_requirements_check.py (PR #201, merged 4804605)
detection.reason: a deploy now refuses to flip to a release with a missing or unsatisfied requirement
